content.about: Rwanda is a small, landlocked country in East Africa, called "the land of a thousand hills". Its green hills grow tea and coffee. It is one of the few places to see mountain gorillas. Kigali is known as one of Africa's cleanest cities.

standout.text: Rwanda's Volcanoes National Park is home to mountain gorillas.

didYouKnow: Plastic bags have been banned in Rwanda since 2008.
Rwanda has a high share of women in its parliament.
Umuganda is a monthly national community work day.
